skills.name: tengrade
skills.description: Use TenGrade's MCP tools to list, build, publish exams and manage candidate instances for an organisation. Load this before calling any tengrade tool — it covers the required sequencing for the two credit-spending tools (publish_exam, create_instance) and the rate limits that gate the write tools.
